screen.title: Technical Verification
screen.subtitle: Complete these missions to activate your sale. Verified products sell 3x faster.

missions.physicalDesc: Prove you have the product in hand.
missions.physicalInstruction: Take a photo of the actual product next to a piece of paper with your username and today's date.
missions.performanceDesc: Prove the graph performs under stress.
missions.performanceInstruction: Upload a photo of your monitor showing the 3DMark Time Spy result next to your signature paper.

benchmark.step1Desc:
Search for '3DMark' in the Steam store.

Do NOT buy it, it's free.
benchmark.step2Desc:
Look for the 'Download Demo' button.

Remember, you don't need to buy the application.
benchmark.step3Desc:
In the top right bar of the app, look for a button called 'Benchmark'.

Click it and it will take you to the Benchmark section.
benchmark.step4Desc:
Scroll down a bit and look for the benchmark called 'Time Spy'.

Click on it.
benchmark.step5Desc: When you are on the screen to run the test, it is recommended to close all applications to obtain a better result.
benchmark.step6Desc:
Once the test is finished, take a photo with your cell phone of the monitor showing:

• The '3DMark' result.
• The taskbar showing the date.

The 3DMark app should not be in full screen. Try to replicate the example image so that everything is clear.

Otherwise, your verification may be rejected.
benchmark.step7Desc:
Write down or save the score of your component that appears in '3DMark' (either CPU or GPU).

You will be asked that you write it in the 'Graphic Score' box when you upload your verification photo.

info.title: Guide: Specs Verification
info.step1Desc: Go to the website and navigate to the 'Downloads' section for AIDA64 (It's safe). It's lightweight and quick to install.
info.step2Desc: Look for the 'Extreme' version, the one labeled 'Portable ZIP,' not the 'EXE package.' Download it; you don't need to buy the application, you can use the trial version.
info.step3Desc: Scroll down a bit and you'll see the download links. Download the first one, which is a ZIP file. Unzip it (right-click on the folder you downloaded and then select 'Extract All') and open the AIDA64.exe application.
info.step4Desc: When you open the program, an ad will appear; click 'OK'. In the top menu, click on the 'RAM' icon, and then click 'Start Benchmark'. Note: Close all other open programs to prevent the program from crashing. You only need to have the benchmark program open.
info.step5Desc: Once the benchmark finishes (when the memory, L1 cache, L2 cache, and L3 cache fields are filled), take a photo with your phone of the monitor showing: • The RAM benchmark result. Try to replicate the example image and make sure everything is clear; otherwise, your verification may be rejected.

mobo.title: Guide: Specs Verification
mobo.step1Desc: Go to the website and navigate to the 'Downloads' section. AIDA64 (It's safe). It's lightweight and quick to install.
mobo.step2Desc: Look for the 'Extreme' version, the one that says 'Portable ZIP', not the 'EXE package'. Download it; you don't need to buy the application, you can use the trial version.
mobo.step3Desc: Scroll down a bit and you'll see the download links. Download the first one, which is a ZIP file. Unzip it (right-click on the folder you downloaded and then extract everything) and open the AIDA64.exe application
mobo.step4Desc: When you open the program, an ad will appear; click 'OK'. In the top menu, click on the 'RAM' icon, and then click 'Start Benchmark'. Note: Close all other open programs to prevent the program from crashing. You only need to have the benchmark program open.
mobo.step5Desc: Download CPU-Z from its official website (it's safe). It's a lightweight program and quick to install. Open it and go to the 'Mainboard' tab.
mobo.step6Desc:
Once the benchmark finishes (when the memory, L1 cache, L2 cache, and L3 cache fields are filled), take a picture with your phone of the monitor showing:

• The RAM benchmark result.

• The CPU-Z tab in the Mainboard section. • The taskbar (The time and date should be displayed). Try to replicate the example image and make sure everything is clear; otherwise, your verification may be rejected
